-- A new crime thriller series from Ozark creator Bill Dubuque, M.I.A. (2026) follows Etta Tiger Jonze, a young woman pulled into Miami’s criminal underworld after her family’s drug-running operation is destroyed in a brutal attack.

After surviving the massacre, Etta sets out on a relentless revenge mission to track down and eliminate the twelve men responsible, forcing her to build a new identity while navigating a violent world of cartels, betrayal, and survival.

The series stars Shannon Gisela, Cary Elwes, Danay Garcia, Alberto Guerra, and Maurice Compte, with guest appearances from Edward James Olmos and Billy Burke.

All episodes premiere May 7, 2026 on Peacock.
